_comment: Four tiers, lightest to strongest. Each maps per provider to family keywords and a default effort. The newest listed model of the first available family is used, so new versions are picked up without edits; a second family is a fallback (codex strongest falls back to sol), and a tier with no available family fails. A provider entry may be {"families": [...], "effort": "..."} to override the effort. Override the whole file with $XLLM_TIERS.
